text:
Luisa: Hey team — AcmeHW asked what exact assurance artifacts we need for the marketplace listing + joint announcement. They want a single bundle they can upload. Any must-haves?

Jonathan: Short answer: SOC2 cover letter + summary, pen test report (redacted), third-party scan summary, and a signed attestation for firmware where applicable. Also a manifest (CSV/JSON) listing filenames + redaction status.

Alex: Can you share the manifest schema? Our SI needs a template to map their attachments to our intake fields.

Jonathan: Manifest fields: filename, sha256, artifact_type (soc2/pen/scan/attestation/questionnaire), redacted (yes/no), redaction_notes. Keep it flat CSV.

Priya: For private deployments we also need HSM/KMS key-wrap evidence and a short note on data residency for the region. Many partners forget the KMS screenshots.

Luisa: Noted. Does the pen test need to be full report or an executive summary + remediation tracker? Acme says they only have a vendor exec summary.

Jonathan: We can accept an exec summary + remediation tracker that includes CVE IDs, severity, status, and fixed-by ETA. Full reports are ok if partner is comfortable redacting PII and internal IP.

Alex: SI asks about upload mechanism and TTL for presigned links — prefer automated so we don't hand-carry keys.

Jonathan: Presigned S3 is fine. Recommend 7 days TTL. Example command we use internally:

```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-assurance/acmehw/assurance-package.zip --expires-in 604800
```
Luisa: Are there any file size limits or collection zips we prefer?

Priya: Keep single archive under 2GB; if larger, split into logical parts and include a root manifest.md listing parts. Also encrypt archives with a passphrase shared separately (we use a short OTP via secure channel).

Ellen: Timeline check — marketing wants to draft the joint announcement copy next week. We need security signoff before public dates. Jonathan, can you commit to reviewing artifacts by 2024-11-08 if we get presigned links by 2024-11-04?

Jonathan: I can review the summary + manifest within 48 hours of receipt; full pen+artifacts will take longer but I'll triage priority items first. 2024-11-08 is doable if links arrive by 11-04.

Luisa: I'll send them the manifest template and presign instructions today. Alex, can SI team package the vendor's questionnaire answers into the CSV manifest?

Alex: Yes, will map questionnaire -> artifact_type=questionnaire and include sha256s.

sec-bot: Reminder: "Marketplace intake checklist" — attach SOC attestation, pen summary, remediation tracker, manifest.csv, firmware attestation (if HW), and contact for redaction questions. See <https://intranet.redwood/workflows/marketplace-intake>. :robot_face:

Ellen: Also flag: for the announcement we need a short security blurb from Jon (1-2 sentences) + a pointer to support docs. Jon, can you provide that after review?

Jonathan: Yep — will draft 2-line blurb after I confirm scope; can do by 11-09 EOD.

Luisa: OK — next steps: I'll DM Acme with presign TTL and manifest template, cc Alex. I'll follow up in this thread when links land. Thanks all :raised_hands:
